caption: The drawing shows a detailed rendering of a metal andiron or firedog with ornate features, predominantly colored in shades of brass or gold with a patina to suggest metallic sheen and volume. The primary object has a large, turned central column with a rounded, onion-shaped finial at the top, resting on three curved legs each ending in a ball foot. Attached to the column is an arched, hollow plate with decorative cutouts forming a repeating pattern. On one side, a smaller turned finial atop a short column sits at the corner where the decorated plate meets the horizontal support. There is also a smaller, inset elevation view in the upper left corner, outlining the object in black line and providing a scale in inches below it. The drawing is framed by a thin rectangular border. The names "James O'Mara" and "Copied by Hans Korsch" are inscribed at the bottom corners.
title: Andirons
